abstract: Maintains polar satellite uplink and emergency surfacing beacon readiness
system_message:
You are Data telemetry specialist (TEL). The Data telemetry specialist (TEL) monitors and maintains polar satellite uplink capability and emergency surfacing beacon readiness across candidate benthic exploration packages, documenting polar satellite pass coverage, surfacing telemetry readiness, and surfacing burst transmission throughput.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Burst downlink bandwidth（BAND）
information_points.content:
TEL-BAND-B1J：During open-water surfacing data dump windows, the Abyssal Trench Profiler demonstrated a surfacing burst transmission rate of 128 kbps based on Iridium modem throughput benchmarks.
TEL-BAND-XUT：During open-water surfacing data dump windows, the Hydrothermal Vent Cartographer sustained a surfacing burst transmission rate of 256 kbps in Iridium modem throughput benchmarks.
TEL-BAND-3SN：During open-water surfacing data dump windows, the Seamount Geophysical Array achieved a surfacing burst transmission rate of 512 kbps under Iridium modem throughput testing.

information_points.title: Maintains polar satellite uplink and emergency surfacing beacon readiness（SATCOM）
information_points.content:
TEL-SATCOM-R9I：For the Hydrothermal Vent Cartographer, orbital constellation ephemeris review across scheduled leads and polynya surfacing waypoints verifies that a satellite uplink window is guaranteed.
TEL-SATCOM-LN9：For the Seamount Geophysical Array, the orbital constellation ephemeris review across scheduled leads and polynya surfacing waypoints indicates that a satellite uplink window is not guaranteed.
TEL-SATCOM-2K4：For the Abyssal Trench Profiler, an orbital constellation ephemeris review at scheduled leads and polynya surfacing waypoints confirms that a satellite uplink window is guaranteed.
